semiconductor_relevance: Low — The lab is primarily focused on research and development in MEMS technology, which is a niche area within the broader semiconductor industry.
summary: Tottori University Microdevice Lab is engaged in research and development of Micro-Electro-Mechanical Systems (MEMS), focusing on micro-preconcentrators, RF-MEMS devices, sensor devices, and metamaterials. Their work includes developing platforms to simplify sensor network construction, showcasing their innovations through research posters and prototypes.
